source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TWM41WH8A / NS-TWM35W1 top-load washer (capacitive level)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: F2 / C9 behavior
steps.body: F2 or C9 indicates PCB failure. Test mode entry failure (lights not ON, display not 88, no beep) also points to PCB.
steps.sourceExcerpt: F2 or C9 indicates PCB failure. Test mode entry failure (lights not ON, display not 88, no beep) also points to PCB.

steps.title: Replace PCBs
steps.oemOutcome: Replace display PCB and/or power/main PCB per failed path.
